purpose: Complete the corrected QfO inferred-species-tree evaluation of the same default and bounded-copy-deferral candidate sets. Combine its six endpoints with the OrthoBench/Three Kingdoms inferred-tree supplement for an eight-endpoint accuracy vector.
hypothesis: Any accuracy changes from the bounded copy-deferral policy must be assessed with each candidate set's own species-tree inference, rather than assuming the fixed-baseline-tree diagnostic represents the full phylogenetic method.
changes: No additional search, clustering, refinement, satellite, root-event or pair-inference parameter changes. Replace the fixed species-tree handoff with native infer mode using the current candidate set. Keep species_overlap, positive_paralogy, min_variance and direct high-confidence satellite retention.
reuse: Reuse the exact admitted HMM-derived candidate and merge files, and all compatible completed raw gene trees from each matching fixed-tree arm. Require every reconciled family to hit its validated raw-tree checkpoint. Do not repeat search/profile scoring or rebuild valid gene trees.
parent_gate: Run only after Slurm 24198 has completed successfully and both fixed-tree arms have terminal independent native-output and score readback. Independently reread those products and scores, snapshot the terminal parent report, and fingerprint all consumed alignment/checkpoint/tree files before new inference. Failed or incomplete parent arms are explicit gaps, not substituted inputs or grounds for an automatic duplicate attempt.
input_resolution: The initial execution plan pins already produced candidate/seed/merge files, original parent plan, FASTAs, tools, frozen source and runtime. Parent raw-tree products still being generated are declared deferred inputs, not falsely called frozen. After authoritative parent completion, resolve them into an immutable input manifest and verify before/after inference and scoring.
control_gates: Control candidate and merge bytes must equal the retained native baseline.
Own-inferred control RootHOG, pair, confidence and rooted-species-tree bytes must reproduce the original native inferred-tree baseline.
Recompute all six assessments and independently read them back; require exact reproduction of the five deterministic control endpoints. FAS remains stochastic.
Both arms retain all 984137 input genes and 78 species, native canonical pairs and confidence annotations, and use infer mode without a supplied tree.
Verify checkpoint identities and complete raw-gene-tree reuse. A failed contemporary control prevents variant inference; preserve every failure.
evaluation: Report VGNC, SwissTrees and supporting TreeFam-A F1, EC/GO/FAS similarity, precision, recall, relation counts, coverage, native pair/family/event counts, marker counts, tree contrasts, failures and incremental resources separately. Compare own-inferred variants against matched own-inferred controls and fixed-tree diagnostics. Use all eight endpoints and Pareto tradeoffs before promotion, preserving the development 0.005 decline screen without statistical-equivalence claims.

resources.dependency: afterany:24199, whose own dependency follows 24198; do not overlap new native arms

limitations: All data are development-exposed; this does not establish independent biological confirmation.
Cached upstream HMM graphs/candidates/raw trees with candidate-specific native species-tree inference; not fresh full-pipeline execution or timing.
Shared-host incremental timing is confounded and FAS is unseeded.
The first fixed-tree variant has not been scored at prespecification. Keep both arms and the fixed 500-gene ceiling regardless of subsequent exposed scores.
A complete metric vector and reproducible improvement are required before considering default promotion.
